description: This file declares the SetVolume class, which is a task for setting the volume in a WebAudio player context within the Rialto media server. It includes necessary headers, defines the class with its constructor, destructor, and execute method, and contains private members for context, a GstWrapper, and volume level.

classes.name: SetVolume
classes.description: A task class responsible for setting the volume in the WebAudio player context.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with the player context, GstWrapper, and volume level.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to set the volume.
